operations.text:
1. Define the `Role`, `ApplicationStatus`, `DecisionOutcome` and `DocumentVerificationStatus` enums in `backend/src/types/enums.py` (new).
2. Define the `User` and `AuditEntry` value objects in `backend/src/types/identity.py` (new), typing `User.role` as `Role` from `backend/src/types/enums.py`.
3. Define the SQLAlchemy declarative base, the engine/session factory (reading `backend/src/config/settings.py`, owned by E15-S1) and the initial `app_user`, `product` and `policy_version` table classes — the SQLAlchemy table registry every later story appends one table class to — in `backend/src/repository/models.py` (new).
4. Register the database liveness probe with the health endpoint: call `register_database_probe(...)` from `backend/src/api/platform/routes.py` (owned by E15-S1, existing) with a check that issues `SELECT 1` through the session factory from step 3. E15-S1 ships the probe as a port and `GET /health` reports `database: "unconfigured"` until this story wires it; the frozen contract requires `database: "ok"`, and `E15-S2-AC1`'s "all three report healthy" only becomes meaningful once the probe is real.
5. Define `UserRepository.get_by_username(username) -> User | None` in `backend/src/repository/identity/user_repository.py` (new), reading the `app_user` table from `backend/src/repository/models.py`.
6. Define `ProductRepository.list() -> list[LoanProduct]`, `ProductRepository.get(product_code) -> LoanProduct`, and a tracer-scoped `ProductRepository.save_threshold(product_code, threshold_kind, value: Money, actor) -> PolicyVersion` (inserts a new insert-only `policy_version` row and activates it via the `product.active_policy_version_id` pointer write, per D-A/D-E — never a flag on `policy_version`) in `backend/src/repository/policy/product_repository.py` (new); money values use `Money` from `backend/src/types/money.py` (owned by E9-S1, existing).
7. Add `backend/migrations/versions/0001_identity_catalog_policy.py` (new): creates the `app_user`, `product` and `policy_version` tables and seeds one `CUSTOMER`, one `UNDERWRITER` and one `ADMIN` user plus at least one Loan Product with one activated Policy Version, satisfying AC1 and AC2's seed data.
8. Define `authenticate(username, password) -> str` (signed JWT carrying `sub`, `role`, `exp`; TTL from `Settings.jwt_ttl_seconds = 3600` per D-M) and `current_user(token) -> User` in `backend/src/service/identity/auth.py` (new), using `UserRepository` from step 5 and PyJWT.
9. Define the `get_current_user` FastAPI dependency (reads the `Authorization: Bearer` header, calls `auth.current_user`) in `backend/src/api/deps.py` (new).
10. Define `POST /auth/login` and `GET /auth/session` in `backend/src/api/identity/routes.py` (new): login returns `{ access_token, token_type, user }`; session names exactly one `Role` and drives the landing surface — covers AC1. As the first statement of the login handler, before any call that could log, `register_sensitive(credentials.password)` imported from `backend/src/config/logging.py` (owned by E15-S1, existing): redaction is registration-driven, so a credential that is never registered is never scrubbed, and a validation error or traceback on the login path would otherwise carry the plaintext password. The issued token is registered the same way before it is returned.
11. Define the `LoanProduct`, `PolicyVersion` and `Threshold` response models (money fields typed via `MoneyField` from `backend/src/api/serializers.py`, owned by E9-S1, existing) and the routes `GET /products`, `GET /products/{product_code}` and `POST /products/{product_code}/policy-versions` in `backend/src/api/policy/routes.py` (new); each route calls `ProductRepository` from step 6 directly with no intervening service, per the shallow-list decision in `component-map.md`; the POST route requires only an authenticated actor (via `get_current_user` from step 9), is declared `status_code=201` (the frozen check `QA-VM-014` expects 201 and FastAPI defaults a POST to 200), and returns the new `policy_version_id` — the full ADMIN-only enforcement is deferred to E1-S2 per this story's Scope Out and per D-F, which rules out any per-route hand-written role check here — covers AC2 and AC3.
12. Append one `include_router` line for `identity.routes.router` and one for `policy.routes.router` to the app factory's router registry in `backend/src/api/app.py` (owned by E15-S1, existing) — the one legitimate shared-surface edit.
13. Define the API base URL and other runtime config reads in `frontend/src/config/env.ts` (new).
14. Define the `Role`, `ApplicationStatus`, `DecisionOutcome` and `DocumentVerificationStatus` TS enums mirroring `backend/src/types/enums.py` in `frontend/src/types/enums.ts` (new).
15. Define the Role-to-landing-surface map in `frontend/src/config/roles.ts` (new), keyed by `Role` from `frontend/src/types/enums.ts`.
16. Define the wire DTO shapes `User`, `LoanProduct`, `PolicyVersion` and `Threshold` in `frontend/src/types/api.ts` (new); money fields are the quoted 2dp wire string parsed via `Money.fromWire` from `frontend/src/types/money.ts` (owned by E9-S1, existing).
17. Define the fetch wrapper `request()` (base URL from `frontend/src/config/env.ts`, attaches the `Authorization: Bearer` header, stores/reads the session token) in `frontend/src/api/client.ts` (new).
18. Define `login()` and `getSession()` calling `POST /auth/login` and `GET /auth/session` in `frontend/src/api/auth.ts` (new), built on `frontend/src/api/client.ts`.
19. Define `listProducts()`, `getProduct()` and `saveThreshold()` calling `GET /products`, `GET /products/{product_code}` and `POST /products/{product_code}/policy-versions` in `frontend/src/api/products.ts` (new).
20. Define `Login.tsx` (new) in `frontend/src/ui/pages/Login.tsx`: a login form posting via `frontend/src/api/auth.ts` and redirecting to the role's landing surface from `frontend/src/config/roles.ts` — covers AC1.
21. Define `Catalog.tsx` (new) in `frontend/src/ui/pages/Catalog.tsx`: the shallow product list for any role (AC2) and, for an ADMIN session, an inline threshold-edit control calling `saveThreshold()` and re-reading the product in the same running process to confirm the new `policy_version_id` with no restart — covers AC3 and AC4.
22. Define the frontend route registry — the shared registry every later screen appends one route entry to — with the login and catalog routes in `frontend/src/ui/routes.tsx` (new).
23. Define the top-level app shell in `frontend/src/ui/App.tsx` (new): mounts the router from `frontend/src/ui/routes.tsx` and holds the session state consumed by `frontend/src/api/client.ts`.
24. Verify AC1-AC4 against the endpoints wired in steps 10 and 11 using the existing evaluator-run API checks `QA-VM-012` through `QA-VM-015` recorded in `specs/test_artefacts/test-plan.md`; this tracer story's bundle owns no dedicated pytest file (`tests.layers: ["api"]`), so live evaluation against the seed data from step 7 is this story's acceptance mechanism for AC1-AC4.
